exact_steps: Operator cleared Pattern 1 and armed recording with REC; leftmost step flashing.
Host waited 600 ms, then sent 90 3C 00 alone.
Host waited 600 ms, then sent 90 3C 00 alone a second time.
Host waited 600 ms, then sent 90 41 5A, waited 300 ms, sent 80 41 00.
Operator reported four lit steps with the cursor flashing on step 5.
Operator left record mode and started playback.

observations.resulting_sequencer_behaviour: Two silent steps were recorded. Playback emitted note 60, then note 65 500 ms later, which is three step widths, with the loop still 1500 ms.
observations.record_time_device_output: None. The FM1 transmitted nothing while recording; every captured message is either a later playback pass or was sent by the host.

record_evidence.analysis_notes: No hardware record bytes have been captured. These fixtures observe stock behaviour only and say nothing about the internal record layout.

comparison.only_intended_difference: a second velocity-0 Note On added
comparison.differential_result: Rests accumulate one step per velocity-0 Note On: no rest gave 166 ms between the two notes, one rest 333 ms, two rests 500 ms.

notes: SEQ-001B capture. Standard channel MIDI only: no SysEx, vendor, loader, OTA or flash traffic in either direction.
